cohort: Mothers and infants enrolled in the Women and Infants Integrated Interventions for Growth Study (WINGS) in North India
finding: Breastfeeding counselling significantly improved EIBF and EBF rates at 1, 3, and 5 months of age compared to the control group.
mod_finding: The impact of the intervention was greater on exclusive breastfeeding in preterm small for gestational age (PT-SGA) infants at 3 and 5 months of age.
birth_weight: Appropriate for gestational age (AGA) and small for gestational age (SGA) infants
